import { Icon } from "@astrojs/starlight/components";

Below the list of rules supported by Biome, divided by group. Here's a legend of the emojis:
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended"><Icon name="approve-check-circle" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> indicates that the rule is part of the recommended rules.
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule has a safe fix"><Icon name="seti:config" label="The rule has a safe fix" /></span> indicates that the rule provides a code action (fix) that is **safe** to apply.
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule has an unsafe fix"><Icon name="warning" label="The rule has an unsafe fix" /></span> indicates that the rule provides a code action (fix) that is **unsafe** to apply.
- The icon <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is not released yet"><Icon name="moon" label="This rule is not released yet" /></span> indicates that the rule has been implemented and scheduled for the next release.

## `a11y`

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [useGenericFontNames](/linter/rules/use-generic-font-names/css) | Disallow a missing generic family keyword within font families. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [noImportantStyles](/linter/rules/no-important-styles/css) | Disallow the use of the `!important` style. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span><span class='inline-icon' title="The rule has an unsafe fix" ><Icon name="warning" label="The rule has an unsafe fix" size="1.2rem" /></span> |

| [noUnknownProperty](/linter/rules/no-unknown-property/css) | Disallow unknown properties. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noUnknownPseudoClass](/linter/rules/no-unknown-pseudo-class/css) | Disallow unknown pseudo-class selectors. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |

## `nursery`

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [noDuplicateSelectors](/linter/rules/no-duplicate-selectors/css) | Disallow duplicate selectors. |  |
| [noExcessiveSelectorClasses](/linter/rules/no-excessive-selector-classes/css) | Limit the number of classes in a selector. |  |
| [noInvalidPropertyInitValue](/linter/rules/no-invalid-property-init-value/css) | Checks that the `initial-value` of an `@property` rule follows the value format declared by its `syntax`. |  |
| [noUndeclaredCustomProperties](/linter/rules/no-undeclared-custom-properties/css) | Reports custom properties used with `var()` that have no visible declaration. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is not released yet"><Icon name="moon" label="This rule is not released yet" size="1.2rem" /></span> |
| [noUnusedClasses](/linter/rules/no-unused-classes/css) | Reports CSS class selectors that are never referenced in any JSX or HTML file. |  |
| [useBaseline](/linter/rules/use-baseline/css) | Disallow CSS properties, values, at-rules, functions, and selectors that are not part of the configured Baseline. |  |
| [useNamedLayer](/linter/rules/use-named-layer/css) | Disallow anonymous cascade layers. |  |

## `style`

| Rule name | Description | Properties |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [noDescendingSpecificity](/linter/rules/no-descending-specificity/css) | Disallow a lower specificity selector from coming after a higher specificity selector. | <span class='inline-icon' title="This rule is recommended" ><Icon name="approve-check-circle" size="1.2rem" label="This rule is recommended" /></span> |
| [noExcessiveLinesPerFile](/linter/rules/no-excessive-lines-per-file/css) | Restrict the number of lines in a file. |  |
| [noHexColors](/linter/rules/no-hex-colors/css) | Disallow hex colors. |  |
| [noValueAtRule](/linter/rules/no-value-at-rule/css) | Disallow use of `@value` rule in CSS modules. |  |
